name: Meliá Serengeti Lodge
positioning: Safari lodge in the Nyamuma Hills of Serengeti National Park, built with local natural materials and Maasai colours (officially Meliá Serengeti Lodge Meliá Collection)
best_for: Travelers who want game drives, walking safaris and balloon flights from one lodge

facts.text: The lodge is in the Nyamuma Hills in Serengeti National Park, Tanzania.
Rooms are inspired by Maasai traditions, with views of the hotel gardens or the Serengeti plains.
Safari Experience rooms include a half-day safari in a shared Jeep and a picnic in the savannah.
Game drives can be taken in a private vehicle, tailored to guests' interests and pace.
The balloon safari includes a bush breakfast in the wilderness.
The hotel offers Maasai cultural storytelling and lessons led by traditional warriors.
Guests can join a live beading demonstration with the resident Maasai artist.
The spa's treatments are based on concepts combining beauty, harmony, vitality, nature and nutrition.
At the gym, guests can also work out outside with views of the Serengeti.
The hotel offers a personalized butler service.
Boma is an a la carte restaurant in a typical Maasai building with a fireplace and a terrace.
The colonial-style bar serves Tanzanian coffees and teas, spirits from across Africa and local gins.

highlights.text: The walking safari is a one-and-a-half-hour walk guided by experts, a local Maasai and a ranger.
The balloon safari flies over the Serengeti plains at dawn.
The lodge has an infinity pool with views of the Serengeti.
The hotel is built using local natural materials, organic shapes and traditional Maasai colours.
The hotel offers a visit to the traditional Maasai village at Fort Ikoma.

considerations.text: The lodge is remote: 36 km from Seronera Airport and 335 km from Arusha.
Spa treatments come at an extra charge.
WhataHotel notes that the seasonal wildlife migration affects viewing opportunities.
